name: One-Direction Large Arrow
spec: yellow horizontal rectangle with one large black arrow pointing right
meaning: The road ahead turns in the arrow direction; you must turn.

snippets.back: A large arrow placed on the outside of a turn and chevron signs at curves both stress the need to slow down for a sharp change of direction.
Curve warnings are usually yellow diamonds, while a ninety-degree bend may have a large arrow on a yellow rectangle.
A ONE DIRECTION LARGE ARROW warns of an extreme change in direction that requires slowing before the curve as for an intersection turn.
A TWO DIRECTION LARGE ARROW on the far side of a T-intersection means the driver must choose left or right because the road does not continue straight.
